method: The decision rests on the standing-guard takedown takes takedown-variants-v1254h and v1254k (candidate 1214cs) under the product controller with natural guard AI and the NPC stream on: the source starts 4.5 m behind Dunwall tutorial guard 2 while he stands at his patrol pause, sprints, slides and attacks; the source must play the native slide takedown, the partner must present it, both worlds must agree on the outcome and the victim must end within 2 m; the checkpoint is reloaded after every case. The nonlethal slide (choke_slide_back, census 73) was presented and shared in both roles in audit 1257 and accepted functionally from both windows; in 1254h/k/m the slide-choke input never slid (the source walked up and choked from behind, and the guard broke free), so those cases are kept as failed.

items.scope: The slide assassination (assassination_slide_back, 2000-2333 ms) in both source roles in two takes: presented on the partner, the guard dead in both worlds at the same place; the slide choke (census 73) from audit 1257.

visual.verdict: Corvo slides in behind the guard and strikes as he rises; the guard falls and Corvo stands over the body.
Emily slides in low behind the guard and strikes; he pitches forward onto the floor and she straightens behind him.
